label: Default — already mid-arc

recentEvents.value: Watched the Glass as he pulled a gate seal off a Heavy Hand and called it a trophy. A medic's badge. He collects them like ears.
Heavy Hands once pulled a barn off a family; Ket watched. The hero pulls badges off the Heavy Hands. They do different work.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He hears 'medic's badge' and files it under 'elite monster loot'. Of everyone at the hub, Ket is furthest along the escalation arc already.

temporaryObjective.value: Say it to his face once, plainly — mugging a paramedic is not a victory — then get back to the post.

notes: Deliberately starts further along the escalation arc than the other hub NPCs (profile notes): his 'default' is already mid-arc. He knows fact_ogre_seals_are_credentials but not fact_trophies_are_gate_seals.
